messages:
tara (DevEx): FYI customer onboarding hit a bad rotation edge: sample app started failing auth after we rotated the project key. repro below.
mike (SDK): ouch. did they have both org and project keys in env?
tara (DevEx): yes. container had REDWOOD_PROJECT=team-zoom and both keys: REDWOOD_API_KEY=org_old and REDWOOD_PROJECT_KEY=proj_new. after replacing proj key, app kept using org_old and got 403s.
sana (Eng): logs show header `Authorization: Bearer org_old`. SDK env resolution currently prefers API_KEY if present. that breaks project-scoped rotations.
mike (SDK): that explains it. will change precedence: when REDWOOD_PROJECT is set, prefer REDWOOD_PROJECT_KEY over REDWOOD_API_KEY. otherwise use API key as org fallback.
lucy (Infra): can we make server error clearer? current 403 message is generic. suggest returning JSON like `{code: "auth_scope_mismatch", detail: "token not valid for project team-zoom"}` and add header `x-redwood-scope: project` so clients can detect scope issues.
tara (DevEx): also recommend a one-time SDK startup warning if both keys are present: "Both REDWOOD_API_KEY and REDWOOD_PROJECT_KEY set. If REDWOOD_PROJECT is configured, project key will be used." Would avoid a lot of support tickets.
mike (SDK): agreed. adding console.warn (one-time) + a `redwood doctor --auth` lint that flags both keys. also adding unit tests for env precedence matrix.
sana (Eng): and change retry policy: do not retry on 401/403 that look like auth mismatches. only retry on 429/5xx. otherwise rotation creates request storms.
lucy (Infra): infra will implement structured error + header. we'll also emit a metric for auth.scope_mismatch to track onboarding pain.
mike (SDK): PR opened: https://git.internal/pulls/2102 - flips precedence, adds warning, doctor check, and no-retry-on-auth. cutting patch release sdk-js@0.11.1. changelog: "Fix env precedence when REDWOOD_PROJECT is set; warn when both org/project keys present; avoid retrying on auth errors; better guidance for rotations."
support-bot: support-ticket #4521 updated: note added about rotation checklist and `redwood doctor`.
tara (DevEx): validated quickstart + sample app in staging. rotation now succeeds when replacing project key without falling back to the org key. shipping onboarding doc update. closing out.
